title: Habit, copying, templates and line position, mixed
statement: The text is predicted better by a mixture of a memorized vocabulary, a habit chain on the previous word, copying a recent word on the page with at most one glyph changed (window 20), a prefix-core-suffix template, line-position vocabularies and a glyph trigram speller than by a bag of words; each component is a procedure a scribe could carry out without meaning. Component sizes were chosen on a validation slice of the practice training pages only.
